856: func (ash *Handler) newEmbeddedSigningAuthority(ca *caddypki.CA, authorityConfig caddypki.AuthorityConfig) (*authority.Authority, error) {
857: 	rootCert := ca.RootCertificate()
858: 	var signerOption authority.Option
859: 	if authorityConfig.SignWithRoot || ash.signLeavesByRoot || ash.SignWithRoot {
860: 		issuerKey, err := ca.RootKey()
861: 		if err != nil {
862: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading signing key: %v", err)
863: 		}
864: 		signerOption = authority.WithX509Signer(rootCert, issuerKey.(crypto.Signer))
865: 	} else {
866: 		signerOption = authority.WithX509SignerFunc(func() ([]*x509.Certificate, crypto.Signer, error) {
867: 			issuerCert := ca.IntermediateCertificate()
868: 			issuerKey := ca.IntermediateKey().(crypto.Signer)
869: 			if ash.logger != nil {
870: 				ash.logger.Debug("using intermediate signer",
871: 					zap.String("serial", issuerCert.SerialNumber.String()),
872: 					zap.String("not_before", issuerCert.NotBefore.String()),
873: 					zap.String("not_after", issuerCert.NotAfter.String()))
874: 			}
875: 			return []*x509.Certificate{issuerCert}, issuerKey, nil
876: 		})
877: 	}
878: 	opts := []authority.Option{
879: 		authority.WithConfig(&authority.Config{
880: 			AuthorityConfig: authorityConfig.AuthConfig,
881: 		}),
882: 		signerOption,
883: 		authority.WithX509RootCerts(rootCert),
884: 	}
885: 	if authorityConfig.DB != nil {
886: 		opts = append(opts, authority.WithDatabase(*authorityConfig.DB))
887: 	}
888: 	auth, err := authority.NewEmbedded(opts...)
889: 	if err != nil {
890: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("initializing certificate authority: %v", err)
891: 	}
892: 	ash.signLeavesByRoot = authorityConfig.SignWithRoot
893: 	return auth, nil
894: }
